x_calendar_page.lore.rare: Swaps its own pictures overnight, so March has a snowman and December has a beach.

x_diary.lore.legendary: Locked itself so tightly that the bank borrowed its tiny key to guard the gold.

x_file_folder.lore.rare: Sorts the papers inside by colour every night, so the tax form now lives next to a tomato soup recipe.

x_folder.lore.legendary: Grew so fat with worksheets that it needed its own seat on the school bus, and its own ticket.

x_journal.lore.legendary: Described a hidden waterfall so well that explorers searched for a year, then found it in its owner's back garden.

x_notebook_pad.lore.rare: Copies the doodles from the next desk onto its own pages, so maths homework comes back covered in horses.
x_notebook_pad.lore.legendary: Remembered its notes so well that it sat the exam by itself, and got a better mark than its owner.

x_notepad.lore.legendary: Wrote call Gran so messily that a real gorilla rang back, and Gran says they chat every Sunday now.

x_planner.lore.legendary: Booked the sunset for half past seven, and the sun turned up exactly on time.

x_ring_binder.lore.epic: Snapped its rings round the school register, so nobody could be marked in and the whole school was officially absent.
x_ring_binder.lore.legendary: Grew so many dividers that it found a subject nobody had ever taught, and now the school has lessons in it on Fridays.

x_bible.lore.rare: Falls open at the page where someone once pressed a flower, and sneezes dried petals onto the table.

x_paper_crane.lore.legendary: Was folded so perfectly that a flock of real cranes landed on the roof to ask it for directions.
x_paper_crane.lore.epic: Flapped its paper wings so hard at the school fair that the bunting took off and flew to the next town.

envelope.lore.epic: Licked its own flap shut on the postman's sleeve, so he delivered the whole street with one arm.

x_atlas.lore.epic: Fell open on the teacher's foot, and the class spent a week learning a country that turned out to be a coffee stain.
x_atlas.lore.legendary: Added a tiny island to its own map, and when sailors finally found it, a deckchair was waiting.

x_bookend.lore.epic: Leaned on the books so hard that the shelf slid through the wall, and the neighbours started borrowing them.
x_bookend.lore.legendary: Held up a row of encyclopedias so well that the shelf underneath retired, and it has held them in mid-air ever since.

x_booklet.lore.legendary: Explained a robot kit so clearly that the robot read it too, and built itself a little brother.

x_bookmark.lore.rare: Moves itself back ten pages every night, so its reader has now read the same chapter forty times.
x_bookmark.lore.legendary: Kept its page so stubbornly that the library was rebuilt round the book rather than move it.

x_brochure.lore.epic: Showed a beach so sunny that the bus shelter it was left in came out with a tan line.
x_brochure.lore.legendary: Made a holiday sound so good that the island on its cover sent a postcard asking to visit the family.

x_leaflet.lore.common: Slides under the doormat instead of on top, so nobody finds it until the spring clean.
x_leaflet.lore.rare: Folds itself into a paper hat on whoever picks it up, and they wear it all day without noticing.
x_leaflet.lore.epic: Advertised a pizza deal so loudly that the whole street ordered at once, and the pizza shop ran out of dough by six.

x_canvas_print.lore.rare: Copies whoever stands in front of it into the picture, so the famous lady now has Dad's moustache.

x_chalkboard.lore.legendary: Taught a parrot its times tables so well that the parrot now runs the school maths club.

x_comic.lore.epic: Was left on the school bus, and by home time the driver was announcing every corner in speech bubbles.
x_comic.lore.legendary: Ended on a cliffhanger so tense that its reader's goldfish waited at the edge of the bowl for a month.

x_dictionary.lore.epic: Was dropped in assembly and fell open on a word so long that the head teacher is still pronouncing it.
x_dictionary.lore.legendary: Invented a word so useful that everyone started saying it, and now it sits in all the other dictionaries looking smug.

x_encyclopedia.lore.epic: Was used as stepping stones across a flooded kitchen, and the family learned about volcanoes on the way to the kettle.
x_encyclopedia.lore.legendary: Answered a question that nobody had asked yet, and three weeks later somebody asked it.

x_flag.lore.epic: Flapped so hard at sports day that it pulled its pole out of the ground and won the sack race on its own.
x_flag.lore.legendary: Waved the start of a race so fast that the runners finished before the whistle, and had to run it again backwards.

x_flyer.lore.legendary: Was photocopied so many times that the last copy showed a completely different cat, and that cat came home too.

x_glue_stick.lore.epic: Was left without its lid in the art cupboard, and every crayon in school stuck together into one giant rainbow log.
x_glue_stick.lore.legendary: Glued a falling leaf back onto its tree so well that the tree kept it all winter, and the other trees were jealous.

x_greeting_card.lore.rare: Rewrites its own message to suit whoever opens it, so the plumber got a card saying Get Well Soon, Grandma.
x_greeting_card.lore.epic: Was so big that it would not fit through any door, so the whole birthday party was held in the front garden.
x_greeting_card.lore.legendary: Sent its love so hard that it arrived the day before it was posted.

x_birthday_card.lore.epic: Played its tinny tune inside the postbox, and the postman delivered the whole street while dancing.
x_birthday_card.lore.legendary: Sang its birthday tune so many times in one day that the whole family turned a year older, and it had to send them all apology cards.

sewing_machine.lore.rare: Sews everything within reach, including the tablecloth to its owner's skirt.

x_hole_puncher.lore.epic: Punched two extra holes in the school timetable, and the whole school went to the wrong lessons for a week.
x_hole_puncher.lore.legendary: Punched a hole so neat in a rainy sky that the sun came through it, and the picnic went ahead.

x_label_maker.lore.legendary: Labelled the clouds so clearly that the weather forecaster now just reads them out.

x_stapler_remover.lore.rare: Pulls out every staple in the room at once, so the noticeboard, the homework and the teacher's cardigan all fall apart.
x_stapler_remover.lore.epic: Unstapled the school play's script the night before, so the actors performed every page in a different order.
x_stapler_remover.lore.legendary: Pulled one staple from the corner of the office calendar, and the whole year fell off the wall at once.

x_tape_gun.lore.rare: Tapes down anything that stops moving, so moving day ended with the sofa taped to the ceiling.

x_banknote.lore.common: Gets folded and refolded so many times that it opens like a tiny accordion.

x_paper_sheet.lore.epic: Got printed on both sides at once, so the head teacher's letter told every parent the school was closed and open.

x_paper_stack.lore.rare: Gives a paper cut to anyone who tries to count it, so nobody knows how many sheets are left.
x_paper_stack.lore.epic: Was used to level the wobbly table at the big meeting, and when someone needed paper the whole meeting fell over.
x_paper_stack.lore.legendary: Stacked itself so high that the top sheet reached the clouds, and the weather now prints its forecasts on it.

x_photo_album.lore.legendary: Showed a baby photo so embarrassing that the baby, now a grandad, tried to post the album to the Moon.

x_photo_frame.lore.rare: Changes the smile in its photo to match the mood of the room, and sulks when nobody dusts it.
x_photo_frame.lore.epic: Was turned round by the cat every night, so the family woke up to a different uncle on the mantelpiece each morning.
x_photo_frame.lore.legendary: Fitted so many relatives into one photo that the frame had to grow an extension, and the dog is now in the attic part.

x_picture_frame.lore.epic: Fell off its hook during the party and landed perfectly round the dog, who is now the family portrait.
x_picture_frame.lore.legendary: Framed a sunset so beautifully that the sun refused to set without it, and evenings now last an extra hour.

x_trading_card.lore.epic: Was swapped so many times in one break that it came back to its owner worth twice as much.
x_trading_card.lore.legendary: Was so rare that the other cards in the pack asked for its autograph.

x_postcard_stack.lore.legendary: Had so many postcards from one aunt that the family worked out she'd been everywhere at once, and she won't say how.

x_pop_up_book.lore.legendary: Popped up a castle so big that it could not be closed again, and the family now lives in it at weekends.

x_picture_book.lore.epic: Had its flaps lifted so many times that the hiding animals packed up and moved into the next book on the shelf.
x_picture_book.lore.legendary: Was read so many times that it learned the story by heart, and now reads itself aloud while the grown-ups snore.

x_manga.lore.epic: Was dropped in the bath, and its sound effects floated off the page and filled the bathroom with BOOMs.
x_manga.lore.legendary: Ended its story so perfectly that the characters asked for a holiday, and the next volume was just them at the beach.

x_menu_card.lore.legendary: Described a pudding so well that diners felt full just reading it, and the restaurant now only sells menus.

x_magazine_stack.lore.rare: Hides the one magazine you want at the very bottom, and moves it to the top the moment you leave.
x_magazine_stack.lore.epic: Was so out of date that the waiting room read about a heatwave and turned up in shorts in December.

x_newspaper_stack.lore.uncommon: Has one string tied round it so tight that nobody can slide a paper out.
x_newspaper_stack.lore.rare: Grows taller every time someone says they'll recycle it tomorrow.
x_newspaper_stack.lore.legendary: Was stacked so high that the top paper was tomorrow's, and the family brought umbrellas a day early.

x_paint_tube.lore.rare: Squirts paint at whoever squeezes it hardest, so art class always ends with one very blue teacher.
x_paint_tube.lore.epic: Was stepped on in the art room, and a trail of red footprints led straight to the culprit, the class hamster.
x_paint_tube.lore.legendary: Painted a door on the school wall so realistically that the caretaker now has to unlock it every morning.

x_painting.lore.epic: Followed one visitor round the gallery with its eyes so hard that it fell off its hook and landed in the gift shop.

x_pamphlet.lore.epic: Described a lost tortoise so well that the whole market searched for it, and found it asleep on the cheese stall.
x_pamphlet.lore.legendary: Persuaded the town's pigeons to hold a meeting, and now they gather every Tuesday to demand more bread.

x_paper_clip.lore.epic: Was bent into a little sculpture during a dull meeting, and a gallery bought it for more than the company made that year.

x_paper_plane.lore.epic: Glided onto the roof of a bus and rode all the way to the seaside, then sent back a postcard.
x_paper_plane.lore.legendary: Was thrown in the playground on Monday and landed on Friday, after stopping for lunch in France.

x_receipt.lore.epic: Was found in a coat pocket a year later, and the shop refunded a sofa the family had sat on all winter.
x_receipt.lore.legendary: Faded so completely that the whole shop forgot the sale had happened, and gave everyone their money back.

x_receipt_roll.lore.common: Curls up so tightly that it springs off the till and rolls away under the counter.
x_receipt_roll.lore.epic: Printed a joke at the bottom of every receipt by mistake, and the supermarket queue laughed so hard nobody paid.

x_ticket.lore.epic: Got its number smudged, so three hundred people thought they had won the raffle, and the prize was one goldfish.
x_ticket.lore.legendary: Was torn so neatly by the usher that both halves went to the show, and each one claimed the same seat.

x_easel.lore.epic: Blew over at the park painting day and stamped a wet sunset onto the back of a passing horse.
x_easel.lore.legendary: Held a canvas so steady in a hurricane that the painting came out calm, and the hurricane stopped to look.

x_sketchbook.lore.epic: Had its drawings escape one night, and the family woke to a sketchy cat chasing the real one round the kitchen.
x_sketchbook.lore.legendary: Drew the cat so perfectly that the real cat moved out, and now the drawing gets fed twice a day.

x_stained_glass.lore.legendary: Coloured a puddle so beautifully that the ducks queued to have their baths in it.
x_stained_glass.lore.epic: Coloured the sunset so brightly that the whole school photo came out tartan.
x_stained_glass.lore.rare: Paints a coloured glow onto whoever stands in its light, and it takes three baths to wash off.

x_tapestry.lore.rare: Changes its stitched story when nobody is looking, so the knight now loses to a duck.
x_tapestry.lore.epic: Was unrolled for the castle open day and turned out to be so long that the visitors had to read it from a bus.
x_tapestry.lore.legendary: Stitched a dragon so convincing that the castle's knights still won't walk past it after dark.

x_wall_art.lore.uncommon: Is so abstract that every visitor argues about which way up it goes.
x_wall_art.lore.epic: Was hung upside down at the museum, and three art experts wrote whole books about why.
x_wall_art.lore.legendary: Was so modern that the cleaner threw it away, and the dustbin is now on display in a gallery.

x_poster.lore.rare: Peels itself off the wall whenever its band comes on the radio, and dances on the bedroom floor.
x_poster.lore.legendary: Faded in the sun until the band on it became a different band, and the new band is better.

x_hair_clip.lore.epic: Snapped shut on the school photographer's fringe, so the whole class photo was taken by the caretaker.
x_hair_clip.lore.legendary: Held a fringe so firmly that its owner went through a wind tunnel and came out looking like the school photo.

x_hair_tie.lore.epic: Pinged off a ponytail in assembly and landed in the head teacher's tea, and nobody owned up for a month.
x_hair_tie.lore.legendary: Pinged off a ponytail so hard that it landed on the Moon, and is now the only hair tie whose location is known.

x_hairpin.lore.common: Slides out of a bun one by one, so its owner leaves a little trail behind her like breadcrumbs.
x_hairpin.lore.rare: Springs out of a bun the moment its owner walks on stage, and takes the whole hairdo with it.
x_hairpin.lore.epic: Was used to fix the ballet curtain, and pinged loose in the final dance so the curtain came down on the swan.
x_hairpin.lore.legendary: Pulled a thorn out of a lion's paw at the zoo, and the lion now wears it in its mane.

x_hula_hoop.lore.rare: Spins so fast that whoever is inside it lifts off the ground like a little helicopter.
x_hula_hoop.lore.epic: Rolled off down the school field and took the whole PE lesson chasing it all the way to the ice-cream van.
x_hula_hoop.lore.legendary: Was spun round the middle of the Earth for a dare, and the whole planet wobbled to keep it up.

x_safety_pin.lore.legendary: Held a bouncy castle together for a whole birthday party, and the children only noticed when it started to squeak.

x_pin_cushion.lore.epic: Was left on a bus seat, and the driver stopped at the hedgehog rescue centre in case it was one of theirs.
x_pin_cushion.lore.legendary: Held so many pins that it turned magnetic, and now every lost key in town turns up stuck to it.

x_push_pin.lore.uncommon: Holds up a notice so long after it's out of date that the school fair is still being advertised in March.
x_push_pin.lore.legendary: Pinned the school timetable so firmly that the clock gave up and followed it instead.

x_thumbtack.lore.epic: Was spilled in the school corridor, so the whole school had to tiptoe to lunch like ballet dancers.
x_thumbtack.lore.legendary: Pinned the end of a rainbow to the school wall so it couldn't fade, and the playground has been very colourful since.

x_sewing_needle.lore.epic: Was dropped in the toy box, and every teddy came out with its ears sewn on a little tighter.
x_sewing_needle.lore.legendary: Threaded itself through the eye of a storm and stitched it so tight that it fizzled into a breeze.

x_thimble.lore.rare: Taps on the table so impatiently that the sewing machine speeds up just to stop the noise.
x_thimble.lore.epic: Tapped out a rhythm so catchy that the knitting circle next door dropped their needles and started a conga.
x_thimble.lore.legendary: Pushed a needle through a castle curtain so thick that it came out the other side next Tuesday.

x_thimble_small.lore.epic: Was borrowed as a bucket by a beetle at the beach, and the beetle built the tallest sandcastle in the bay.

x_tie_clip.lore.epic: Clipped the groom's tie to the wedding cake by mistake, so the first dance happened round the table.
x_tie_clip.lore.legendary: Clipped a runaway kite string to a lamp post, and the kite now flies over the town every day like a pet.

x_crochet_hook.lore.rare: Hooks any loose thread it passes, so jumpers unravel whenever their owners walk by.

x_knitting_needles.lore.legendary: Knitted a jumper for a sheep that had just been sheared, and the sheep wore it to the farm show.

x_level_tool.lore.epic: Found the kitchen table wonky, so the family sawed a leg, then another, until dinner was served on the floor.
x_level_tool.lore.legendary: Got its bubble so perfectly in the middle that the sea went flat for a day, and the surfers sent a complaint.

x_set_square.lore.rare: Turns every corner it touches into a perfect right angle, including the round birthday cake.
x_set_square.lore.epic: Was used to plan the school garden, and every flower now grows at exactly ninety degrees.
x_set_square.lore.legendary: Made a corner so perfect that a spider moved in and spun the world's first square web.

x_protractor.lore.rare: Turns any corner it is laid on into a curve, so the classroom now has a round door.

x_ruler_tool.lore.epic: Was twanged on the edge of the desk so hard that the whole class's pencil pots took off like rockets.
x_ruler_tool.lore.legendary: Measured the distance to the Moon one ruler at a time, and only had to stop for lunch twice.

x_rubber_band.lore.rare: Twangs a note so low that every window in the classroom hums along.
x_rubber_band.lore.legendary: Stretched round a runaway hot-air balloon and pinged it gently back down onto the school field.

x_whiteboard.lore.rare: Wipes itself clean the moment the teacher turns round, so the homework never gets copied down.
x_whiteboard.lore.legendary: Had DO NOT WIPE written on it so long ago that the school was rebuilt round it, and it still hasn't been wiped.

x_soldering_iron.lore.rare: Sticks every wire it touches together for good, so the headphones are now part of the radio.
x_soldering_iron.lore.epic: Fixed the school bell so well that it now rings every five minutes, and lessons are very short.
x_soldering_iron.lore.legendary: Soldered a radio so cleverly that it picks up dolphins chatting, and they mostly talk about fish.

x_stylus.lore.epic: Drew a line off the edge of the tablet and kept going across the table, the wall and the cat.
x_stylus.lore.legendary: Drew a cartoon dog so lively that it barked at the postman through the screen.

x_credit_card.lore.legendary: Paid so smoothly that the shop paid it instead, and it still gets a thank-you letter every month.

x_toothpick.lore.legendary: Picked the teeth of a crocodile at the zoo, and the crocodile now smiles at every visitor.

x_laser_pointer.lore.rare: Leaves its red dot on the wall even after it's switched off, and the cat has been guarding it for a week.
x_laser_pointer.lore.legendary: Led a cat on a chase round the whole town and back in one evening, and the cat came home fitter than the dog.

x_letter_paper.lore.rare: Turns every Dear into Darling overnight, which made the letter to the bank very awkward.
x_letter_paper.lore.legendary: Was sent to a pen pal so far away that it came all the way round the world back to its writer, who wrote back.

x_scrapbook.lore.legendary: Kept a pressed flower so carefully that it bloomed again, and now the scrapbook has to be watered.

x_cigarette_butt.lore.common: Hides between the paving stones where no broom can reach it.
x_cigarette_butt.lore.legendary: Was found by a beach-cleaning robot that was so offended it chased it all the way to the bin.

x_vape.lore.uncommon: Leaves a sickly sweet smell in the car that even the air freshener complains about.
x_vape.lore.legendary: Made such a thick fog at the bus stop that the lighthouse switched on and a fishing boat parked in the high street.
